ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram shown, which organism consumes the phytoplankton?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower left of the figure is labeled “Phytoplankton”, and above it is “Zooplankton”. From “Phytoplankton” there is an upward dashed arrow pointing to “Zooplankton”. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that food or energy flows from the organism being eaten to the consumer. Because the arrow points from phytoplankton to zooplankton, the organism that consumes phytoplankton is zooplankton.
